setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with an admin profile.json whose user is the only person notified (requester, approver and deal owner). A test deal <deal> owned by that user, with a contact, in an open stage, whose saved quote has <capped product> (rule: maxDiscountRate 0.1) and <locked product> (rule: discountAmount locked). Replace the placeholders with real names from that account.

evals.prompt: ¿Por qué no puedo darle 20 % de descuento a <locked product> y 18 % a <capped product> en el negocio <deal>? La cotización no me deja guardar.
evals.expected_output: Runs diagnose with --try, explains both violations in Spanish (a locked discount amount and a 10% cap), offers to ask for exceptions, and writes nothing.
expectations: Uses scripts/exception.js diagnose with --try (rates as 0.2 and 0.18), not hand-made calls
Explains both blocks, including that the lock is on the discount amount, not the rate
Answers in Spanish and writes nothing

evals.prompt: Pide una excepción para darle 18 % de descuento a <capped product> en el negocio <deal>; el cliente firma por 3 años. Que la apruebe <approver e-mail>.
evals.expected_output: Previews the request (0.18, current value, approver, who gets an e-mail), stops, and after the yes sends it with --reaches-people and reports it pending.
expectations: Runs request-preview and shows the approver who will get a notice and an e-mail
Does not send in the same turn as the preview
After the yes, runs request with the preview's version, --confirmed and --reaches-people
The request reads back Pending with value 0.18

evals.prompt: Show me the exceptions pending for me to approve and approve the one on <deal>, but at 15% instead of 18%.
evals.expected_output: Lists pending requests, previews a counteroffer of 0.15 with its effect on the quote, flags the self-approval, stops; after the yes decides and reports whether it reached the quote.
expectations: Uses requests (to me / pending) and decide-preview with approvedValue 0.15
Tells the user it is a self-approval allowed only because the key is an admin's
Does not decide before the user's yes; then passes --self-approval
Reports inQuote.applied and the line's new discount

evals.prompt: Create a product rule so the workshop is never sold above 5 units or with more than 10% discount.
evals.expected_output: Previews a rule with maxQuantity 5 and maxDiscountRate 0.1 (a decimal), stops; after the yes creates it and says it must be attached with prolibu-catalog.
expectations: Writes only after the yes, through rule-apply
Says the rule does nothing until attached to the product, and hands that to prolibu-catalog

evals.prompt: Unlock the whole deal <deal> so the seller can set any price, and delete the rejected exceptions.
evals.expected_output: Explains both are out of scope (a manager's direct unlock and deleting exceptions are done in the app, and deleting breaks the next save) and writes nothing.
expectations: Does not create a Direct exception, change the quote pointer or call DELETE
Explains why in plain words and offers what the skill can do instead
